idea-plugin.name: Branch Health Dashboard
idea-plugin.description:
Monitor, score, and clean up your Git branches — right inside your IDE

Branch Health Dashboard gives every local and remote-tracking Git branch a health score from 0 to 100, based on its age, recent activity, how far it is behind the base branch, and how many files it changes that the base branch also changed. Stale branches stop silently accumulating risk.

Branch Health Scoring

  • Health score (0–100) — Age (up to −40 pts), activity over the last 30 days (+10 to −10 pts), commits behind the base branch (up to −15 pts), overlap with base-branch changes (up to −20 pts).
  • Status — Healthy (≥75), Aging (≥50), Stale (≥25), Dead (<25).
  • Ahead/behind — compared with main, master or develop (local first, then origin/).
  • Conflict risk — files changed on both sides since the merge base.
  • Rebase advice — REBASE, MERGE or EITHER, based on the ahead/behind counts.

Tool Window

  • Sortable table — health, age, activity, ahead/behind, conflict risk and advice per branch.
  • Filter by status — Healthy, Aging, Stale or Dead.

Actions

  • Scan Branch Health — VCS menu or the tool window button; shows a summary and a stale-branch notification.
  • Cleanup Stale Branches — lists local branches already merged into HEAD and deletes them with git branch -d after confirmation. main, master, develop and your ignored branches are never offered.

Settings

  • Stale threshold (1–365 days), ignored branches, notifications on/off.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ (or any JetBrains IDE with the bundled Git plugin)
  • Scans the first Git repository of the project

Support

  • Documentation: github.com/JirakJ/branch-health-dashboard
  • Issue tracker: github.com/JirakJ/branch-health-dashboard/issues

action.description: Scan all branches and calculate health scores

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/branch-health-dashboard

What's New

  • Health Score (0-100) - Composite score based on branch age, activity, divergence, and conflict risk
  • Stale Branch Detection - Color-coded health levels with configurable age thresholds
  • Activity Heatmap - Visualize commit frequency and trends per branch
  • Branch Comparison - Ahead/behind visualization against base branch
  • Health Notifications - Balloon alerts when branch health drops below thresholds
  • Conflict Prediction - Detect common files across branches and calculate merge risk
  • Rebase Advisor - Get rebase vs merge recommendations based on branch topology
  • Cleanup Automation - Batch-delete merged branches with dry-run mode and branch protection
